title: Synthesis and sintering of AgNWs@PVP core–shell structures for improved transparent electrodes
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,6162-6170
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08659G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Tang Xianjie, Gan Guoyou, Chen Shouzhi, Yu Xianglei, Qian Zhuo, Li Junpeng
In this study, a simple method for the synthesis of AgNWs@PVP core–shell structures is proposed, the effects of sintering temperature and time on their morphology are investigated, and the sintering mechanism is summarized.
